What's the relationship between nutmeg and mace?
Same plant (*M. fragrans*), same fruit — nutmeg = seed kernel, mace = dried red aril around seed shell
Is nutmeg really psychoactive?
Yes, via myristicin → MMDA metabolism. Requires ~5–15g for effect. Culinary use (~1–2g) negligible. Effects are dysphoric and delayed — not a desirable drug.
What makes clove oil a legitimate painkiller?
Eugenol: Na+ channel blocker + TRPV1 modulation + COX inhibition. Used in dentistry as local anesthetic/antiseptic. Not folk medicine.
What was the VOC?
First joint-stock corporation with tradeable shares, with sovereign powers (could make war). Founded 1602 to monopolize spice trade.
Why does Grenada have nutmeg on its flag?
Pierre Poivre brought nutmeg plants from Banda to Mauritius (1770); eventually spread to Grenada, which became major producer.
What did the Dutch trade for Run Island?
New Amsterdam (Manhattan). They kept the nutmeg island, gave up what became the most valuable real estate in world history.
